description: One of three RAF Akrotiri gate guardians, mounted near the main gate area. It wears 56 Squadron markings although it served almost its whole career with 11 Squadron. By 2013 the canopy and windows had been painted over and the pitot and refuelling probe heads were missing. Thunder and Lightnings last confirmed it in situ in August 2014; Esri imagery of 7 October 2024 shows a slim dart-shaped object at the recorded position, partly under tree cover.

RAF Akrotiri gate guardian, sited about 80 m from the Lightning. Recorded as preserved by spottingmode WRO location 6472. Last independent photographic confirmation traced is June 2008 on ABPic; no evidence of removal has been found and RAF Akrotiri is consistently described as having three gate guardians.

RAF Akrotiri gate guardian at a road junction about 400 m north-east of the Lightning. Recorded as preserved by spottingmode WRO location 6473, last updated June 2015. A helicopter-shaped object is present at the position in Esri imagery of 7 October 2024.
